text: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good.
reflection: What hurt you was real, and it was wrong. Yet God can weave even this wound into a story of good you cannot see yet.

text: The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still.
reflection: You don't have to fight this battle in your own strength. Let God stand in front of what overwhelms you while you simply rest.

text: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them; for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.
reflection: A broken heart can make you feel abandoned. God promises the opposite: He walks right beside you and will never leave.

text: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms.
reflection: When everything gives way, you don't fall into nothing. His everlasting arms are underneath you, holding you up.

text: Don’t call me Naomi. Call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.
reflection: Naomi was honest about her bitterness, and God did not turn away from her. You can be honest too; your story isn't over.

text: She was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to the LORD, and wept sore.
reflection: Hannah brought her tears straight to God. You don't need tidy words; your weeping can be your prayer.

text: Man looks at the outward appearance, but the LORD looks at the heart.
reflection: Others may only see the surface, but God sees your heart, every hidden ache, and He looks on it with love.

text: In my distress I called on the LORD. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple.
reflection: Your cry does not disappear into silence. Even from the depths of distress, God hears your voice.

text: I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will heal you.
reflection: Not one of your tears has gone unnoticed. The God who sees them is also the God who heals.

text: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.
reflection: God does not leave the wounded where they fell. His hands bind up what is broken and make it whole again.

text: For I know that my Redeemer lives, and at last he will stand upon the earth.
reflection: In the middle of unbearable loss, Job held on to this: his Redeemer lives. That hope is still yours today.

text: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I shall come out like gold.
reflection: God knows the road you are walking, even the parts that feel like fire. You will come through, refined like gold.

text: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
reflection: It's okay to admit you are faint and worn out. Ask for mercy; God is gentle with hearts that are tired.

text: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
reflection: Even the psalmist cried himself to sleep. Your tears are not weakness, and God has made room for them.

text: The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.
reflection: Your prayer has been heard and received. Rest in knowing God has accepted every word you have brought Him.

text: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed, a high tower in times of trouble.
reflection: When life presses hard, God is a high tower, a safe place to run to and hide.

text: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear.
reflection: God listens closely to humble, hurting hearts. He is already preparing yours to receive His comfort.

text: How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
reflection: 'How long?' is a prayer God welcomes. You can bring Him your questions as well as your trust.

text: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
reflection: Even while you wait for answers, you can lean on His unfailing love. Joy is still possible on the other side.

text: In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice.
reflection: When you call out in distress, your voice reaches God. He hears you, every time.

text: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.
reflection: God never looks away from your pain. When you cry out, He does not hide His face. He hears.

text: The LORD is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul.
reflection: Let the Shepherd lead you to quiet places. He knows how to restore a soul that feels emptied out.

text: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me.
reflection: This valley is real, but you are not walking it alone. The Shepherd is with you, every step.

text: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted. The troubles of my heart are enlarged.
reflection: When you feel desolate, you can ask God to turn toward you. He meets the lonely and the afflicted with mercy.

text: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
reflection: Hold on to this confidence: you will still see God's goodness, not only someday, but here in this life.

text: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.
reflection: Waiting is hard when your heart is hurting. Be strong one small moment at a time, and wait for the Lord.

text: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
reflection: The psalmist cried out and was healed. Bring your broken heart to God, the One who restores.

text: Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
reflection: This night of weeping will not last forever. Morning is coming, and with it, joy.

text: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness.
reflection: God specializes in turning mourning into dancing. Trust Him to bring gladness back into your life.

text: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye is consumed with grief. Yes, my soul and my body.
reflection: Grief can wear down both body and soul. God's mercy reaches every part of you that hurts.

text: I said in my haste, ‘I am cut off from before your eyes.’ Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
reflection: Even when you feel cut off from God, He is still listening. Your feelings are not the final word.

text: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
reflection: God hears the cry of His people and delivers them. Your troubles do not have the last say.

text: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
reflection: God draws closest when your heart is breaking. You are not too broken for His nearness.

text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.
reflection: Life can bring many afflictions, but none of them is bigger than God's power to carry you through.

text: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
reflection: Every sigh and longing is already known to God. Nothing in your heart is hidden from His care.

text: I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry. He also brought me up out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay.
reflection: God hears your cry and lifts you from the pit. In time, He will set your feet on solid ground again.

text: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, ‘Where is your God?’
reflection: Some days tears feel like your only food. God does not shame your sorrow; He stays with you in it.

text: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I will still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
reflection: Speak gently to your own downcast soul: hope in God. Praise will rise again.

text: The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song will be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.
reflection: By day His love is near, and by night His song is with you. You are held around the clock.

text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
reflection: When trouble comes, God is not far away. He is your refuge and strength, present right now.

text: Be still, and know that I am God.
reflection: Let your striving heart be quiet for a moment. Be still, and remember who God is.

text: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me. Fearfulness and trembling have come on me.
reflection: Even the faithful have felt crushed by fear and pain. Your anguish is not a sign that God has left you.

text: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you.
reflection: This burden is too heavy for you to carry alone. Cast it on the Lord; He will sustain you.

text: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your bottle. Aren’t they in your book?
reflection: God keeps track of every tear you cry. Your pain is precious to Him, and none of it is forgotten.

text: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
reflection: When your heart is overwhelmed, ask God to lead you to the Rock that stands higher than your pain.

text: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him. He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
reflection: Find rest in God alone. He is your rock and fortress, and with Him you will not be shaken for good.

text: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.
reflection: Pour out your whole heart before Him: the anger, the sorrow, the questions. God is a safe refuge for all of it.

text: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
reflection: God has helped you before, and He is helping you now. Rest in the shadow of His wings.

text: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck. I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold.
reflection: When it feels like you're sinking with nothing to stand on, cry out like the psalmist. God hears desperate prayers.

text: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, will let me live. You will bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
reflection: The God who allowed you to see hard days will also restore your life and bring you up from the depths again.

text: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
reflection: When your heart and strength fail, God remains the strength of your heart, forever.

text: My voice is to God, and I will cry out; my voice is to God, and he will hear me. In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord.
reflection: In your day of trouble, keep crying out to God. He hears you, even when the night feels long.

text: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
reflection: Call on God in your trouble with confidence. He will answer you.

text: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
reflection: God is merciful and gracious, slow to anger and overflowing with love. That is how He looks at you right now.

text: LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you. Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.
reflection: Some prayers come from a very dark place. God makes room for honest lament, and He keeps listening day and night.

text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
reflection: When your thoughts spin with worry and grief, His comfort can still bring your soul delight.

text: Hear my prayer, LORD. Let my cry come to you. Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress.
reflection: You can ask God plainly not to hide from you in your distress. He hears the prayers of the hurting.

text: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.
reflection: Like a tender father, God feels compassion for you. He knows your pain and treats you gently.

text: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy. Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
reflection: God bends down to listen to you. Because He hears, you can keep calling on Him for as long as you live.

text: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow. Then I called on the name of the LORD.
reflection: When sorrow and trouble wrapped around him, the psalmist called on God's name. You can do the same today.

text: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
reflection: Let your soul return to rest. God has been good to you before, and He will be good to you again.

text: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
reflection: God delivers souls from death, eyes from tears, and feet from stumbling. He is working your rescue too.

text: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
reflection: In seasons of affliction, God's Word can breathe new life into you. Let it be your comfort today.

text: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
reflection: Ask God to let His unfailing love be your comfort, just as He has promised.

text: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word. My eyes fail for your word. I say, ‘When will you comfort me?’
reflection: Waiting for comfort can be exhausting. Keep hoping in His Word; His comfort is on its way.

text: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
reflection: Trouble and anguish may surround you, but God's Word can still be a source of delight and steadiness.

text: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
reflection: The tears you are sowing now are not wasted. One day you will reap with songs of joy.

text: Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD. Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
reflection: No depth is too deep for God to hear you. Cry out from wherever you are.

text: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you will revive me.
reflection: Even in the middle of trouble, God preserves your life and revives your heart.

text: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell my trouble before him. When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my way.
reflection: When your spirit grows faint, God still knows your way. Tell Him everything that troubles you.

text: Hurry to answer me, LORD. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me. Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you.
reflection: Ask God to let you hear of His unfailing love in the morning. Tomorrow can begin with His kindness.

text: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
reflection: God is near to everyone who calls on Him in truth. You only need to call.

text: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
reflection: God heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds. He is tending to yours with great care.

text: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
reflection: When nothing makes sense, you don't have to understand it all. Trust God; He will make your path straight.

text: The heart knows its own bitterness, and no stranger shares its joy.
reflection: Others may not fully understand your bitterness, but God knows your heart completely.

text: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
reflection: A crushed spirit drains you of life. Ask God to slowly restore your cheer, one small joy at a time.

text: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance.
reflection: This is a season to weep and mourn, and that's okay. A time to laugh and dance will come again.

text: He has swallowed up death forever; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces.
reflection: One day God will wipe the tears from every face. Your sorrow has an ending.

text: Comfort, comfort my people, says your God.
reflection: Hear God's tender words to His people: 'Comfort, comfort.' He wants to comfort you today.

text: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom.
reflection: Like a shepherd, God gathers the hurting lambs into His arms and carries them close to His heart.

text: But those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
reflection: When grief leaves you weary, wait on the Lord. He will renew your strength to rise again.

text: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you.
reflection: Don't fear, and don't be dismayed. God is with you, strengthening you and holding you up.

text: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you.
reflection: The waters may be deep, but they will not sweep you away. God is with you in the flood.

text: He was despised, and rejected by men; a man of suffering, and acquainted with grief.
reflection: Jesus knows sorrow and grief firsthand. You are loved by a Savior who truly understands your pain.

text: Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering.
reflection: Jesus carried our griefs and sorrows. You don't have to carry yours alone.

text: My loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed, says the LORD who has compassion on you.
reflection: Even if mountains shake, God's love for you will not be shaken. His promise of peace stands firm.

text: I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble.
reflection: The Holy One draws near to the crushed and lowly in spirit, to revive and refresh them.

text: The Lord GOD’s Spirit is on me; because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted.
reflection: Jesus came to bind up the brokenhearted. Your healing is part of His mission.

text: To give to them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness.
reflection: God can trade your ashes for beauty and your mourning for joy. Let Him begin the exchange.

text: As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you.
reflection: As a mother comforts her child, so God comforts you: tenderly, patiently, closely.

text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
reflection: Even now, God's plans for you are for peace and a hopeful future. This pain is not the end.

text: I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
reflection: God promises to turn mourning into joy and to bring comfort and gladness in place of sorrow.

text: For I have satiated the weary soul, and every sorrowful soul have I replenished.
reflection: God sees your weary soul and promises to refresh and satisfy it.

text: It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
reflection: Because of God's great love, you are not consumed. His mercies are brand new this morning.

text: For the Lord will not cast off forever. For though he cause grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
reflection: Grief does not last forever. God's compassion and unfailing love will have the final word.

text: Come, and let us return to the LORD; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us.
reflection: Return to the Lord with your wounds. He is the One who heals and binds up.

text: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
reflection: God is good, a strong refuge in the day of trouble, and He knows you when you run to Him.

text: The LORD your God is in the midst of you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love.
reflection: God is with you, mighty to save. He quiets you with His love and rejoices over you.

text: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
reflection: Jesus calls those who mourn blessed, because comfort is coming to them. Your grief is seen.

text: Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
reflection: Come as you are, heavy and tired. Jesus is gentle and humble, and He will give your soul rest.

text: He has sent me to heal the brokenhearted.
reflection: Jesus was sent to heal the brokenhearted. Your broken heart is exactly what He came for.

text: Jesus wept.
reflection: Jesus wept. He does not stand far off from your grief; He enters it and weeps with you.

text: Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
reflection: Don't let your heart be troubled. Trust in God, and trust in Jesus, who holds your life.

text: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you... Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
reflection: Jesus gives a peace the world can't offer. Let His peace settle your troubled heart.

text: You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
reflection: Your sorrow is real, but Jesus promises it will be turned into joy.

text: In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.
reflection: Trouble is part of life in this world, but Jesus has overcome it. Take heart.

text: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
reflection: Today's sufferings are heavy, but they are not the whole story. Glory is coming that will outweigh them.

text: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
reflection: God is at work in all things, even this, for the good of those who love Him.

text: ...nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
reflection: Nothing, not grief, loss, or heartbreak, can separate you from the love of God in Christ.

text: Blessed be... the Father of mercies and God of all comfort; who comforts us in all our affliction.
reflection: God is the Father of mercies and the God of all comfort. He comforts you in every trouble.

text: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair; pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed.
reflection: You may be hard pressed, but you are not crushed. Struck down, but not destroyed. God holds you.

text: Therefore we don’t faint; but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.
reflection: Even as you feel worn down, God is renewing your inner self day by day. Don't lose heart.

text: Casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
reflection: Hand every worry and heartache to God. He cares for you deeply.

text: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more.
reflection: One day there will be no more tears, death, sorrow, or pain. Hold on to that promise.

text: This time I will praise the LORD.
reflection: Leah named her son from a place of praise, not from what she lacked. Today, choose to praise God for what He has given.

text: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
reflection: Thanksgiving remembers rescue. God has been your strength and your song; let that memory lift your heart today.

text: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
reflection: Gratitude grows when we tell it. Share one thing God has done for you with someone today.

text: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
reflection: God's goodness isn't seasonal. His loving kindness has never run out, and it never will.

text: Now therefore, our God, we thank you, and praise your glorious name.
reflection: Everything we have comes from His hand. Pause and thank Him by name for His glory and generosity.

text: For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
reflection: When the people sang this simple truth, God's presence filled the temple. Let it fill your day too.

text: They bowed themselves with their faces to the ground on the pavement, and worshiped, and gave thanks to the LORD, saying, ‘For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.’
reflection: Sometimes the right response to God's goodness is simply to bow. Worship Him for who He is.

text: They sang to one another in praise and thanksgiving to the LORD: ‘For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.’
reflection: They sang thanks while the foundation was still being laid. You can give thanks before the work is finished.

text: The joy of the LORD is your strength.
reflection: Joy in the Lord isn't just a feeling; it's strength. Let gratitude fuel you for whatever today holds.

text: They offered great sacrifices that day, and rejoiced; for God had made them rejoice with great joy.
reflection: God Himself gives the joy worth celebrating. Let your heart rejoice in what He has done.

text: I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
reflection: Thank God for being righteous and fair. He always does what is right, and you can trust His ways.

text: I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
reflection: Whole-hearted thanks means holding nothing back. Recall His wonderful works and tell of them.

text: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
reflection: Gratitude doesn't have to stay private. Let your thanks to God be heard and seen.

text: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart trusts in him, and I am helped.
reflection: Trust leads to help, and help leads to praise. Thank God for the times He has shielded you.

text: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his, and give thanks to his holy name.
reflection: Thanksgiving is something we share. Join with God's people in thanking Him for His holiness.

text: To the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever.
reflection: Let your heart sing rather than stay silent. Gratitude is meant to last a lifetime.

text: I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
reflection: Praise isn't only for good days. Practise blessing the Lord at all times, in every circumstance.

text: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.
reflection: Your story of God's faithfulness can encourage others. Give thanks where others can hear.

text: Many, LORD my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us.
reflection: God's thoughts toward you are too many to count. Try naming a few of His wonderful works today.

text: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.
reflection: Thanksgiving is an offering we bring to God. Give Him the gift of a grateful heart today.

text: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me.
reflection: A thankful heart honours God. Every 'thank You' becomes an act of worship.

text: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
reflection: Tell someone what God has done for your soul. Gratitude multiplies when it's shared.

text: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
reflection: Thanksgiving makes God look as great as He is. Sing your praise and let Him be magnified.

text: We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.
reflection: God's name is near; He is not distant. Give thanks for His presence and His wondrous works.

text: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forevermore.
reflection: Praise with your whole heart, forever. God is worthy of more than half-hearted thanks.

text: It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High.
reflection: Giving thanks is simply good for the soul. Start and end your day by thanking Him.

text: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
reflection: Come into God's presence with thanksgiving on your lips. It's the best way to begin.

text: Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
reflection: Every day holds a reason to bless God. Proclaim His salvation again today.

text: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all you lands! Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
reflection: Gladness is a beautiful way to serve God. Let your worship be joyful today.

text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
reflection: Thanksgiving is the gateway into God's presence. Enter with gratitude, and you will find Him there.

text: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, and his faithfulness to all generations.
reflection: God's goodness reaches across generations. The faithfulness that held others will hold you too.

text: Praise the LORD, my soul, and all that is within me, praise his holy name. Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits.
reflection: It's easy to forget His benefits. Take a moment to remember what God has done for you.

text: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
reflection: Make His deeds known. Your gratitude can point others to a faithful God.

text: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
reflection: Praise the Lord for His enduring love. It has outlasted every hard season you've walked through.

text: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
reflection: His goodness and love endure forever. That's always reason enough to say thank You.

text: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
reflection: Notice God's wonderful works in your life, and let your thanks rise in return.

text: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
reflection: God satisfies the longing soul and fills the hungry with good things. Thank Him for His provision.

text: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
reflection: Let your mouth be full of thanks. Praise God openly for His goodness to you.

text: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
reflection: Give thanks with your whole heart among God's people. Gratitude grows stronger when it is shared.

text: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
reflection: Ask the psalmist's question: what can I give back for all His goodness? A grateful heart is a good start.

text: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the name of the LORD.
reflection: A sacrifice of thanksgiving costs something when life is hard. Offer it anyway; God treasures it.

text: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
reflection: Start here: God is good, and His love endures forever. Let this truth anchor your gratitude.

text: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
reflection: Thank God for the prayers He has answered. Remembering them builds faith for today.

text: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
reflection: Today is a gift God has made. Choose to rejoice and be glad in it.

text: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you. Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
reflection: Make it personal: You are my God, and I will thank You. His goodness is for you.

text: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
reflection: As you learn God's ways, gratitude grows. Thank Him for guiding you with His truth.

text: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
reflection: Even in the middle of the night, there is reason to give thanks. Let gratitude be your midnight song.

text: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
reflection: Psalm 136 repeats it again and again: His love endures forever. Some truths are worth saying many times.

text: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.
reflection: The God of heaven loves you with a love that never ends. Thank Him for it today.

text: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
reflection: Give God whole-hearted praise. He is greater than anything else that competes for your heart.

text: I will bow toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your name for your loving kindness and for your truth.
reflection: Thank God for His loving kindness and His truth. He keeps every promise He makes.

text: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
reflection: You are fearfully and wonderfully made. Thank God for the person He created you to be.

text: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
reflection: A thankful heart is at home in God's presence. Give thanks, and draw near to Him.

text: I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will bless your name forever and ever. Every day I will bless you. I will praise your name forever and ever.
reflection: Let blessing God become a daily habit. Every day holds something to praise Him for.

text: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.
reflection: All of creation thanks God. Join the chorus with your own grateful heart.

text: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God.
reflection: Sing your thanks to God. Music has a way of lifting gratitude to Him.

text: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!
reflection: If you have breath, you have a reason to praise. Thank God for the gift of life today.

text: In that day you will say, ‘Give thanks to the LORD, call on his name. Declare his doings among the peoples.’
reflection: Call on His name and declare what He has done. Gratitude is a story worth telling.

text: LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you, I will praise your name; for you have done wonderful things.
reflection: God has done wonderful things, planned long ago and carried out faithfully. Praise His name.

text: I will make mention of the loving kindnesses of the LORD, and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD has bestowed on us.
reflection: Recount the Lord's loving kindnesses. Remembering His goodness is the root of thanksgiving.

text: Give thanks to the LORD of Armies, for the LORD is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
reflection: Even after hardship, songs of thanks return. God's goodness restores joy to His people.

text: I thank you and praise you, you God of my fathers, who have given me wisdom and might.
reflection: Thank God for the wisdom and strength He gives exactly when you need it.

text: He went to his house... and he kneeled on his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God.
reflection: Daniel gave thanks even when it was dangerous. Make gratitude a steady habit, whatever comes.

text: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to the LORD.
reflection: From the belly of the fish, Jonah chose thanksgiving. Salvation belongs to the Lord.

text: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation.
reflection: Even when things are lacking, you can rejoice in God Himself. He is your salvation.

text: I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.
reflection: Jesus thanked the Father for revealing truth to the humble. Thank God for opening your eyes to Him.

text: He took the seven loaves and the fish; and he gave thanks and broke them.
reflection: Jesus gave thanks for a little, and it became more than enough. Bring Him what you have, with thanks.

text: He took a cup, and gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, ‘All of you drink it.’
reflection: Jesus gave thanks on the night He was betrayed. Gratitude can be offered even in the hardest hours.

text: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice. He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks.
reflection: One leper came back to say thank you. Don't let God's blessings pass without returning to thank Him.

text: Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?
reflection: Jesus noticed who came back to give thanks. Be the one who returns to Him with gratitude.

text: Jesus took the loaves; and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples.
reflection: Jesus thanked the Father before the miracle, not after. Give thanks in faith for what God will do.

text: Father, I thank you that you listened to me.
reflection: Jesus thanked the Father for hearing Him before Lazarus walked out. Thank God that He hears you.

text: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart, praising God.
reflection: The early church shared meals with glad and simple hearts. Gratitude grows in community.

text: Because, knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, neither were thankful.
reflection: Forgetting to be thankful dims the heart. Choosing gratitude keeps your eyes on the God who gives.

text: But thanks be to God, that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart.
reflection: Thank God for setting you free. Through Christ, you are no longer bound to what once held you.

text: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord!
reflection: When you see your own weakness, remember Jesus. Thank God for rescuing you through Him.

text: He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks.
reflection: Even ordinary meals can become worship. Give thanks for the simple gifts of every day.

text: I always thank my God concerning you, for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus.
reflection: Thank God for the grace at work in the people around you. Gratitude for others is a gift too.

text: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
reflection: Victory is yours through Jesus. Thank God that the final outcome is already won.

text: Now thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ.
reflection: God leads you in triumph in Christ. Thank Him for walking ahead of you.

text: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.
reflection: As grace spreads, thanksgiving overflows. Your gratitude adds to God's glory.

text: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!
reflection: Some gifts are beyond words. Thank God for Jesus, His indescribable gift.

text: I don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers.
reflection: Thank God for the people in your life, and pray for them. Gratitude and prayer belong together.

text: Singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord; giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father.
reflection: Let thanks fill your heart and your songs, always and for everything, in Jesus' name.

text: I thank my God whenever I remember you.
reflection: Think of someone who has blessed you, and thank God for them today.

text: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
reflection: Bring your requests to God wrapped in thanksgiving. Gratitude loosens the grip of worry.

text: Giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light.
reflection: Thank the Father who has made you part of His family and given you a share in the light.

text: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him, rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.
reflection: Rooted in Christ, let your faith overflow with thankfulness. Gratitude keeps you grounded.

text: Let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
reflection: Let Christ's peace rule your heart, and be thankful. Peace and gratitude grow side by side.

text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
reflection: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly, and let it overflow in songs sung with grace in your heart.

text: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
reflection: Whatever you do today, do it in Jesus' name, giving thanks to God through Him.

text: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving.
reflection: Stay devoted to prayer, watchful and thankful. Gratitude keeps your prayers hopeful.

text: Always rejoice. Pray without ceasing. In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
reflection: Give thanks in all circumstances, not for everything, but in everything. That's God's will for you.

text: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks, be made for all men.
reflection: Let thanksgiving be part of how you pray for others. Gratitude makes intercession warm.

text: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, if it is received with thanksgiving.
reflection: Everything God made is good when received with thanks. Gratitude turns ordinary things into gifts.

text: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe.
reflection: You belong to a kingdom that cannot be shaken. Let that steady gratitude shape your worship.

text: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim his name.
reflection: Offer God a continual sacrifice of praise. Let thankful words be the fruit of your lips.

text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.
reflection: Every good gift comes from above. Trace today's blessings back to the Father who never changes.

text: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may show forth the excellent qualities of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
reflection: You were called out of darkness into His marvelous light. Let your life be a thank-you that shows His goodness.

text: Whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever.
reflection: Heaven is full of thanksgiving to the One on the throne. Join that worship today.

text: Amen! Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honor, and power, and might, be to our God forever and ever. Amen.
reflection: Blessing, glory and thanksgiving belong to God forever. Add your own 'Amen' to heaven's praise.

text: We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was.
reflection: Thank God, the Almighty, who is and who was. He reigns, and that is reason for gratitude.

text: Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD... The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still.
reflection: With the sea ahead and an army behind, God told His people to stand still. Some battles are His to fight; your part is to trust.

text: We should go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
reflection: Caleb saw the same giants as everyone else, but he also saw God. Courage looks past the obstacle to the One who is with you.

text: You shall not fear them; for the LORD your God himself fights for you.
reflection: You don't have to fight alone. The Lord Himself fights for you, so fear doesn't get the final word.

text: For the LORD your God is he who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.
reflection: God doesn't send you out and wait at a distance. He goes with you into the fight, to save you.

text: The LORD himself is the one who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed.
reflection: Whatever is ahead of you, God is already there. He goes before you and will not leave you.

text: No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.
reflection: The God who was with Moses promised the same presence to Joshua. He will not fail you or forsake you either.

text: Be strong and courageous; for you shall cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.
reflection: Courage often comes with a calling. God gives strength for the task He has set in front of you.

text: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.
reflection: Be strong and courageous, not because you feel brave, but because God is with you wherever you go.

text: Only be strong and courageous.
reflection: Sometimes the whole message is simple: be strong and courageous. Take the next faithful step.

text: Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed. Be strong and courageous, for thus will the LORD do to all your enemies against whom you fight.
reflection: Remember what God has already done. Past victories give you courage for the battles still ahead.

text: The LORD is with you, you mighty man of valor.
reflection: Gideon felt small and afraid, yet God called him a mighty warrior. God sees strength in you that you may not see yet.

text: You come to me with a sword, with a spear, and with a javelin; but I come to you in the name of the LORD of Armies.
reflection: David faced Goliath with no armour, only the name of the Lord. Your courage rests on who God is, not on what you carry.

text: For the battle is the LORD’s, and he will give you into our hand.
reflection: The battle belongs to the Lord. You can face what's in front of you knowing He is the one who wins it.

text: Be courageous, and let us be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do that which seems good to him.
reflection: Be courageous for the people you love, and leave the outcome with God. He will do what is good.

text: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed.
reflection: Strength and courage are a choice you can make today. Don't let fear or discouragement take the lead.

text: But you, be strong! Don’t let your hands be slack, for your work will be rewarded.
reflection: Don't give up halfway. Keep your hands to the work, because faithful effort is never wasted with God.

text: For the eyes of the LORD run back and forth throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong on behalf of those whose heart is perfect toward him.
reflection: God is searching the earth for hearts that are fully His, so He can strengthen them. Let yours be one.

text: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or dismayed... for there is a greater one with us than with him... with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles.
reflection: The one with you is greater than whatever stands against you. The Lord your God helps you and fights your battles.

text: Arise; for this matter belongs to you, and we are with you. Be courageous, and do it.
reflection: Some things are yours to do, and you don't have to do them alone. Rise up, take courage, and act.

text: Don’t be afraid of them! Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses.
reflection: When fear rises, remember the Lord, great and awesome. Then stand firm for the people and things you love.

text: Who knows if you haven’t come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
reflection: You may be exactly where you are for a reason. Courage sometimes means accepting the moment God has placed you in.

text: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
reflection: Even when it feels like everything is against you, God's protection is bigger. You don't have to live afraid.

text: The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
reflection: When God is your light and salvation, fear loses its grip. Who could be stronger than the strength of your life?

text: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear.
reflection: Even surrounded, your heart can stay steady. Confidence in God holds firm when everything else shakes.

text: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.
reflection: God gives strength to His people, and with it, peace. Ask Him for both today.

text: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas.
reflection: Even if the world feels like it's falling apart, God is still your refuge. You don't have to be afraid.

text: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you. In God, I praise his word. In God, I have put my trust. I will not be afraid.
reflection: Courage isn't the absence of fear. It's choosing to trust God at the very moment you feel afraid.

text: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
reflection: When your trust is in God, the opinions and threats of people lose their power over you.

text: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
reflection: With God, you can act boldly. He is the one who brings the victory.

text: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day.
reflection: God's protection covers the fears of the night and the dangers of the day. Rest in His care.

text: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
reflection: You are watched over more than you know. God cares about every step you take.

text: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
reflection: A heart anchored in God doesn't have to panic at bad news. Trust keeps it steady.

text: His heart is established. He will not be afraid.
reflection: A heart established in God can stand firm. Let His faithfulness steady you against fear.

text: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
reflection: The Lord is on your side. With Him beside you, what can anyone really take from you?

text: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
reflection: When your own strength runs out, God becomes your strength, your song and your salvation.

text: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
reflection: When you call, God answers, and He puts fresh strength in your soul. Call on Him today.

text: Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who teaches my hands to war, and my fingers to fight.
reflection: God is your rock, and He prepares you for the battles you face. You are not unequipped.

text: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear... for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
reflection: Sudden fears don't have to shake you. The Lord is your confidence, and He keeps your feet steady.

text: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a place of refuge for his children.
reflection: Reverence for God is a strong fortress. In Him, His children find a safe place.

text: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
reflection: When you're afraid, run to God. His name is a strong tower, and in Him you are safe.

text: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
reflection: Living right before God gives a quiet boldness. You can stand as bold as a lion.

text: The fear of man brings a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.
reflection: Worrying about what people think can trap you. Trusting God sets you free and keeps you safe.

text: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
reflection: Strength and dignity can be what you wear. With God, you can face the future without fear, even with a smile.

text: Here I am. Send me!
reflection: Courage can be as simple as saying yes to God. 'Here I am. Send me.'

text: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD, the LORD, is my strength and song.
reflection: Trust is the opposite of fear. When God is your salvation, you can choose not to be afraid.

text: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
reflection: Peace comes from fixing your mind on God. A trusting heart is a steady heart.

text: In quietness and in confidence shall be your strength.
reflection: Strength isn't always loud. Sometimes it's found in quiet trust and calm confidence in God.

text: Tell those who have a fearful heart, ‘Be strong! Don’t be afraid!... He will come and save you.’
reflection: If your heart is afraid, hear this: be strong, don't fear. God will come and save you.

text: For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
reflection: Picture God holding your right hand as He says, 'Don't be afraid. I will help you.'

text: Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.
reflection: You are not alone or forgotten. God knows you by name, and you belong to Him.

text: For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint.
reflection: Because God helps you, you can set your face like flint and keep going, even when it's hard.

text: Don’t be afraid, for you will not be disappointed. Don’t be confounded, for you will not be put to shame.
reflection: Don't let fear of failure or shame hold you back. God will not let you be put to shame.

text: No weapon that is formed against you will prevail.
reflection: Whatever is formed against you won't have the last word. God is your defender.

text: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to deliver you, says the LORD.
reflection: When people intimidate you, remember God's promise: 'I am with you to deliver you.'

text: Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, and whose confidence is in the LORD. For he will be like a tree planted by the waters.
reflection: Trusting God makes you like a tree by the water: rooted, steady, still fruitful in hard seasons.

text: Behold, you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm; there is nothing too hard for you.
reflection: The God who made the heavens and the earth is with you. Nothing you face is too hard for Him.

text: Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and mighty things, which you don’t know.
reflection: Call to God. He promises to answer and to show you things you couldn't see on your own.

text: You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words.
reflection: Don't let harsh words or people make you shrink back. God has sent you, and He stands with you.

text: Our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king. But if not, be it known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods.
reflection: True courage says, 'God is able, but even if not, I will stay faithful.' That kind of trust can't be burned away.

text: Man greatly beloved, don’t be afraid. Peace be to you. Be strong. Yes, be strong.
reflection: You are greatly loved. Let that love bring you peace and strength: be strong, yes, be strong.

text: But the people who know their God will be strong, and do exploits.
reflection: Knowing God makes you strong. The closer you walk with Him, the bolder you become.

text: Don’t be afraid, land; be glad and rejoice: for the LORD has done great things.
reflection: Fear gives way to gladness when you remember the great things God has done.

text: But as for me, I am full of power by the Spirit of the LORD, and of justice, and of might.
reflection: Real power comes from God's Spirit. He fills you with the strength to stand for what is right.

text: The Lord, the LORD, is my strength.
reflection: When your strength is gone, His remains. The Lord is your strength.

text: Be strong... and work, for I am with you, says the LORD of Armies.
reflection: Be strong and keep working. You're not building alone; God is with you.

text: ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the LORD of Armies.
reflection: It's not by your might or your power, but by God's Spirit. Lean on Him, not on yourself.

text: Don’t fear those who kill the body, but are unable to kill the soul.
reflection: People can hurt the body, but they can't touch your soul. Your deepest life is safe with God.

text: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
reflection: If God cares for every sparrow, He surely cares for you. You are worth far more to Him.

text: Cheer up! It’s me! Don’t be afraid.
reflection: In the middle of the storm, Jesus says, 'It's me. Don't be afraid.' He comes to you in the waves.

text: Get up, and don’t be afraid.
reflection: Jesus' touch lifts us up. Get up, and don't be afraid; He is right here.

text: With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.
reflection: What feels impossible to you is not impossible for God. Bring Him the thing that looks too big.

text: Don’t be afraid, only believe.
reflection: When fear says it's too late, Jesus says, 'Don't be afraid, only believe.'

text: All things are possible to him who believes.
reflection: Faith opens the door to what God can do. Bring Him even a small, honest belief.

text: Don’t be afraid therefore. You are of more value than many sparrows.
reflection: God knows every detail of your life. You are precious to Him, so you don't have to be afraid.

text: Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
reflection: Your Father delights to give you His kingdom. You can face today without fear.

text: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness.
reflection: The early church didn't pray for the threats to stop, but for boldness. Ask God for courage to speak.

text: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.
reflection: Boldness is a gift of the Holy Spirit. Ask Him to fill you and give you courage today.

text: Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent; for I am with you.
reflection: Don't go quiet out of fear. Speak up, because God says, 'I am with you.'

text: Therefore, sirs, cheer up! For I believe God, that it will be just as it has been spoken to me.
reflection: In the middle of the storm, Paul took heart because he believed God's word. You can too.

text: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, for it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes.
reflection: There is no need to be ashamed of the Good News. It is God's own power to save.

text: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear.
reflection: You are not a slave to fear. God's Spirit makes you His child, and you can call Him Father.

text: If God is for us, who can be against us?
reflection: If God is for you, nothing that stands against you can win in the end.

text: But in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
reflection: In everything you face, you are more than a conqueror through the One who loves you.

text: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
reflection: Stay alert, stand firm in your faith, and be courageous. God gives strength to those who stand.

text: Therefore we don’t faint; but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.
reflection: Even when you feel worn down outwardly, God renews your inner life day by day. Don't lose heart.

text: For when I am weak, then am I strong.
reflection: Your weakness is not the end of the story. It's where God's strength shows up most.

text: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
reflection: You don't have to manufacture strength. Be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.

text: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
reflection: Whatever God calls you to, Christ gives you the strength to face it.

text: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
reflection: Fear isn't from God. He has given you a spirit of power, love and a sound mind.

text: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.
reflection: Don't throw away your confidence in God. Holding on to it brings a great reward.

text: So that with good courage we say, ‘The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?’
reflection: Say it with confidence: the Lord is my helper; I will not fear. What can anyone do to me?

text: Greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
reflection: The One who lives in you is greater than anything in the world. You can face today with courage.

text: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me in.
reflection: Even if the people closest to you let you down, God will take you in. You are never without a home in Him.

text: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing.
reflection: God cares about the lonely and makes a place for them. Ask Him to lead you toward people who can become family.

text: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
reflection: It's okay to tell God you feel alone. He turns toward those who are lonely and hurting.

text: I cried to you, LORD. I said, ‘You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.’
reflection: When no one else seems to notice, God is still your refuge. He is your portion right here, in this life.

text: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence? If I ascend up into heaven, you are there.
reflection: There is nowhere you can go where God is not already there. You are never beyond His presence.

text: If I take the wings of the morning, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea; even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
reflection: Even at the far edge of everything, His hand leads you and holds you. You are not out of reach.

text: You have seen it; for you see trouble and grief, to take it into your hand.
reflection: God sees your trouble and your grief, even what no one else notices. He takes it into His hands.

text: Do not forsake me, LORD. My God, don’t be far from me. Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
reflection: You can pray it plainly: 'Don't be far from me.' God hears that honest cry.

text: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think of me. You are my help and my deliverer.
reflection: Even when you feel overlooked, the Lord thinks of you. He is your help and your deliverer.

text: When I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches. For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
reflection: Lying awake at night, you can turn your thoughts to God. In the shadow of His wings you are not alone.

text: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
reflection: When strength fades and you feel forgotten, God doesn't cast you aside. You can ask Him to stay close.

text: When I said, ‘My foot is slipping!’ your loving kindness, LORD, held me up. In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
reflection: When your thoughts crowd in and you feel yourself slipping, God's loving kindness holds you up.

text: I watch, and am become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
reflection: Feeling like a lone sparrow on a rooftop isn't new. God put that feeling in Scripture so you'd know He sees it.

text: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul. The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forevermore.
reflection: God watches over your going out and your coming in. Every step, every day, you are kept by Him.

text: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
reflection: When loneliness weighs your head down, God is the one who gently lifts it up again.

text: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.
reflection: Even if you go to bed alone, you're not unguarded. Lie down in peace; God keeps you safe.

text: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation. I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.
reflection: Loneliness can feel endless, but you can still choose to trust His loving kindness. He has been good to you.

text: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness.
reflection: God's eye is on you. You are seen by the One who loves you.

text: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him.
reflection: Be still before the Lord. In the quiet, you are not alone; you are resting in Him.

text: Though he stumble, he will not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.
reflection: You may stumble, but you won't be left on the ground. The Lord holds you by the hand.

text: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him.
reflection: Talk to your own heart like the psalmist did: why so downcast? Hope in God; you will praise Him again.

text: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the LORD, ‘He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.’
reflection: There's a secret place where you can dwell with God. Make Him your refuge and your home.

text: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
reflection: Picture being covered under His wings. You are sheltered, close and protected.

text: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
reflection: When you call, God answers. He promises to be with you in trouble.

text: Even to your old age I am he, and even to gray hairs will I carry you.
reflection: Through every season of life, right up to old age, God promises to carry you.

text: Can a woman forget her nursing child...? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you! Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands.
reflection: Even the deepest human love can fail, but God will not forget you. Your name is written on His hands.

text: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
reflection: Encouragement grows in both directions. Reach out to build someone up today; it may lift you too.

text: You will seek me, and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.
reflection: When you seek God with your whole heart, you will find Him. He isn't hiding from you.

text: Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness.
reflection: You are loved with an everlasting love. God has been drawing you close with kindness all along.

text: The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
reflection: God is good to those who wait for Him and seek Him. Your waiting is not unseen.

text: But as for me, I will look to the LORD. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
reflection: When people fall short, look to the Lord. Wait for Him, and trust that He hears you.

text: Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
reflection: Jesus invites the weary to come to Him. Bring the heaviness of loneliness, and find rest.

text: Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.
reflection: Jesus' promise has no expiry date: 'I am with you always.' Not one day of your life is spent without Him.

text: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
reflection: Jesus won't leave you alone like an orphan. He has promised to come to you.

text: I have called you friends.
reflection: Jesus calls you His friend. Whoever else is or isn't around, you have a friend in Him.

text: Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
reflection: Jesus knew what it was to be abandoned by friends, yet He wasn't alone, because the Father was with Him. Neither are you.

text: Rejoicing in hope; enduring in tribulation; continuing steadfastly in prayer.
reflection: Hold on to hope, keep enduring and keep praying. These lonely days won't last forever.

text: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.
reflection: May the God of hope fill the empty places with joy and peace as you trust Him.

text: My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.
reflection: God's grace is enough, even for the lonely ache. His power shows up in our weakness.

text: In nothing be anxious... And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
reflection: Bring every worry to God in prayer. His peace can guard your heart when you feel alone.

text: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
reflection: God knows what you need, including connection and comfort. Trust Him to provide.

text: For he himself has said, ‘I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.’
reflection: God's promise is personal: 'I will never leave you nor forsake you.' Hold on to it today.

text: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace for help in time of need.
reflection: You don't have to approach God timidly. Come boldly, and find mercy and help when you need it most.

text: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you.
reflection: Take one step toward God, and He comes near to you. Closeness with Him begins with a simple turn.

text: Where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.
reflection: Ruth chose loyalty and found a new family. God often brings belonging through faithful people.

text: Two are better than one... For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls.
reflection: We were made to need each other. Don't be afraid to let someone help you up.

text: If one prevails against him, two will withstand him; and a cord of three strands is not quickly broken.
reflection: Friendship with God at the centre is strong. Ask Him to weave lasting bonds in your life.

text: It is not good for the man to be alone.
reflection: From the very beginning, God said it isn't good to be alone. Your longing for connection is part of how He made you.

text: There is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
reflection: There is a friend who sticks closer than a brother. In Jesus, you have that kind of friend.

text: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
reflection: True friends love at all times. Thank God for the ones you have, and be that kind of friend to someone.

text: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
reflection: Sharing joy and sorrow draws people together. Reach out and share life with someone today.

text: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
reflection: You weren't meant to carry everything alone. Let others help bear your burdens, and help bear theirs.

text: See how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
reflection: Unity and togetherness are good gifts from God. Look for a place where you can belong and be known.

text: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go.
reflection: Wherever today takes you, God goes with you and keeps you. You don't face any of it alone.

text: The LORD bless you, and keep you. The LORD make his face to shine on you... and give you peace.
reflection: Receive this blessing slowly: God keeps you, smiles on you and gives you peace.

text: The beloved of the LORD will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all the day long.
reflection: You are beloved, and you can rest secure in Him. God shelters you all day long.

text: David strengthened himself in the LORD his God.
reflection: When everything was falling apart, David found strength in God. You can turn to the same source.

text: Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don't be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the LORD God... is with you.
reflection: The task in front of you may feel huge, but God is with you in it. Take it one step at a time.

text: Don't be afraid... for the battle is not yours, but God's.
reflection: Some pressures aren't yours to carry. The battle belongs to God, so you can loosen your grip.

text: Now submit yourself to him, and be at peace.
reflection: Peace begins when you yield to God instead of trying to control everything. Rest in Him.

text: Give me relief when I am in distress.
reflection: You can ask God plainly for relief. He hears you when you are under pressure.

text: LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you.
reflection: Bring your worries to God first thing in the morning, then watch expectantly for Him to work.

text: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.
reflection: God has never abandoned those who seek Him. Knowing His name makes trust possible.

text: Preserve me, God, for in you do I take refuge.
reflection: When stress closes in, take refuge in God. Ask Him to keep you safe.

text: He also brought me out into a large place.
reflection: Stress can make life feel cramped. God brings His people out into a spacious place.

text: It is God who arms me with strength.
reflection: You don't have to manufacture strength for today. God is the one who equips you.

text: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble.
reflection: May the Lord answer you in your day of trouble. Your prayer is heard.

text: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.
reflection: When you're unsure what to do next, ask God to lead and teach you. Wait on Him.

text: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion.
reflection: In the hardest days, God gives you a hidden shelter in His presence.

text: But I trust in you, LORD... My times are in your hand.
reflection: Your schedule, your future and your time are all in God's hands. You can trust Him with them.

text: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.
reflection: If your hope is in the Lord, you can take heart. He gives strength to those who wait on Him.

text: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble.
reflection: God is your hiding place. When pressure surrounds you, run to Him.

text: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go.
reflection: You don't have to figure out every step yourself. God promises to guide and teach you.

text: The LORD's angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
reflection: God's protection surrounds those who honour Him. You are more guarded than you feel.

text: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this.
reflection: Hand your plans and worries to God. Trust Him, and let Him act.

text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don't fret.
reflection: Fretting only adds to the weight. Let go of anger and worry, and leave things with God.

text: He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
reflection: In times of trouble, God is your stronghold. Lean your weight on Him.

text: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.
reflection: God's invitation is simple: call on Me in your day of trouble. He wants to be your first call.

text: I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning.
reflection: Even after a hard night, morning can bring a song. Sing of His strength and love today.

text: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my hope is from him.
reflection: Find a quiet moment to wait on God alone. Your hope comes from Him.

text: We went through fire and through water, but you brought us out into a place of abundance.
reflection: You may be going through fire and water, but God can bring you out to a better place.

text: For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
reflection: Let God be your confidence, as He has been through every season you've already walked.

text: Nevertheless I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
reflection: On your most stressful days, you are still with God, and He holds your right hand.

text: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
reflection: Ask God to help you use your days wisely. Not everything urgent is truly important.

text: Establish the work of our hands.
reflection: Ask God to bless and establish the work of your hands. Your effort matters to Him.

text: When I said, ‘My foot is slipping!’ your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.
reflection: When you feel your footing slip, God's loving kindness holds you up.

text: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me and set me in a large place.
reflection: When you feel boxed in, call on God. He answers and sets you in a wide-open place.

text: Strengthen me according to your word.
reflection: When you're drained, God's Word can renew your strength. Open it today.

text: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
