reflection: God is your hiding place and your shield. Put your hope in His Word.

text: Great peace have those who love your law. Nothing causes them to stumble.
reflection: Loving God's Word brings deep peace. It keeps your steps steady.

text: In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.
reflection: Cry out to God in your distress. He answers.

text: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
reflection: God never sleeps or loses focus. He is watching over you, so you can rest.

text: I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
reflection: Waiting is hard under pressure. Wait on God and hold on to His Word.

text: I have calmed and quieted my soul.
reflection: Like a child settled in its mother's arms, you can quiet your soul before God.

text: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me.
reflection: God will complete what concerns you. You don't have to hold every loose end.

text: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my path.
reflection: When you're overwhelmed and can't see the way, God already knows your path.

text: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God.
reflection: When you are unsure what to do, ask God to teach you His way. He is your God, and He will guide you.

text: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
reflection: God lifts up those who are weighed down. Let Him raise you up today.

text: A gentle answer turns away wrath.
reflection: Stressful moments can make us sharp. A gentle answer can calm a tense situation.

text: A man's heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.
reflection: You can make plans and still trust God to direct your steps. He is guiding you.

text: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.
reflection: A little with peace is better than more with exhaustion. Give yourself permission to slow down.

text: Trust in the LORD forever; for in the LORD, the LORD, is an everlasting Rock.
reflection: Trust in the Lord forever. He is a rock that never shifts under you.

text: The effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.
reflection: Living rightly with God brings quietness and confidence. Peace grows from the inside out.

text: I, even I, am he who comforts you.
reflection: God Himself is the one who comforts you. Let Him.

text: For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace.
reflection: God's people go out with joy and are led in peace. Ask Him to lead you that way today.

text: The LORD will guide you continually, and satisfy your soul in dry places.
reflection: Even in dry, draining seasons, God guides you and refreshes your soul.

text: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.
reflection: Hope can begin with a choice to remember. Call to mind what God is like.

text: Your Father knows what things you need, before you ask him.
reflection: God knows what you need before you even ask. You don't have to convince Him.

text: Don't be anxious for your life.
reflection: Jesus invites you to stop worrying about life's needs. Your Father cares for you.

text: But seek first God's Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
reflection: Put God first, and trust Him with the rest. He knows how to take care of your needs.

text: Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find.
reflection: Keep asking, seeking and knocking. God listens to your persistent prayer.

text: Come away by yourselves into a deserted place, and rest awhile.
reflection: Even Jesus told His friends to rest. Taking a break is not failure; it's wisdom.

text: Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things, but one thing is needed.
reflection: Like Martha, we get busy and troubled about many things. Only one thing is truly needed: time with Jesus.

text: By your endurance you will win your lives.
reflection: Keep enduring. Patient perseverance holds your life steady.

text: I am the vine. You are the branches.
reflection: You're a branch, not the vine. You don't have to produce everything yourself; stay connected to Jesus.

text: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you.
reflection: Jesus wants His joy to live in you, even on busy and stressful days.

text: Suffering produces perseverance; and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope.
reflection: Hard seasons aren't wasted. God uses them to build perseverance, character and hope.

text: The Spirit also helps our weaknesses.
reflection: When you're too tired or overwhelmed to know what to pray, the Spirit helps you.

text: Be transformed by the renewing of your mind.
reflection: Stress often lives in our thinking. Ask God to renew your mind with His truth.

text: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
reflection: Do what you can to keep peace with others. You're responsible for your part, not theirs.

text: Be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord's work.
reflection: Stand firm and keep going. Nothing you do for the Lord is ever in vain.

text: God is able to make all grace abound to you.
reflection: God is able to give you all the grace you need for whatever today demands.

text: Forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before, I press on.
reflection: Let go of what's behind you. Focus on the next step forward with God.

text: Whatever things are true... think about these things.
reflection: Choose what you dwell on. Fill your mind with what is true, good and lovely.

text: I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
reflection: Contentment is learned. Ask God to help you find peace right where you are.

text: Make it your ambition to lead a quiet life.
reflection: A quiet, steady life is a worthy goal. You don't have to keep up with everyone.

text: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you.
reflection: The Lord is faithful. He will strengthen you and keep you steady.

text: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast.
reflection: Hope in God is an anchor for your soul. It holds firm when everything else is shaking.

text: For you need endurance.
reflection: Endurance is what you need right now. God will give you what it takes to keep going.

text: Let us run with perseverance the race that is set before us.
reflection: Life is a long race, not a sprint. Lay down what weighs you down and keep running.

text: If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally.
reflection: Not sure what to do? Ask God for wisdom. He gives generously and without scolding.

text: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God.
reflection: As you get to know God more, His grace and peace grow in your life.

text: Mercy to you and peace and love be multiplied.
reflection: Receive God's mercy, peace and love today, more than enough for what you face.

text: You will be secure, because there is hope.
reflection: Hope brings security. With God, you can rest even in uncertain times.

text: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
reflection: Keep God in front of you. When He is at your right hand, you won't be shaken.

text: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.
reflection: When life feels unstable, God is your rock, your fortress and your rescuer.

text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
reflection: With the Lord as your shepherd, you have what you truly need.

text: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
reflection: Your Shepherd leads you to rest. Let Him slow you down beside quiet waters.

text: He restores my soul.
reflection: When you feel worn out, God restores your soul.

text: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
reflection: Seek the Lord. He answers and frees you from your fears.

text: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
reflection: When fear and stress rise, choose to trust God in that very moment.

text: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
reflection: True rest for your soul is found in God alone.

text: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
reflection: Make your home in God's presence, and you will rest in His shadow.

text: I will say of the LORD, ‘He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.’
reflection: Say it out loud: the Lord is my refuge and my fortress, my God in whom I trust.

text: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? My help comes from the LORD.
reflection: Lift your eyes from the pressure in front of you. Your help comes from the Maker of heaven and earth.

text: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
reflection: Invite God to search your anxious thoughts. He knows you completely and loves you still.

text: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
reflection: You don't have to understand everything to trust God with everything.

text: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
reflection: Acknowledge God in every part of life, and He will make your path straight.

text: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
reflection: Worry weighs the heart down, and kindness lifts it. Share a kind word today, or receive one.

text: The life of the body is a heart at peace.
reflection: A peaceful heart brings life to your whole body. Peace is good for you.

text: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.
reflection: Commit your work to the Lord. Do your part, and trust Him with the outcome.

text: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
reflection: When you have nothing left, God gives power to the weak and strength to the weary.

text: Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, and whose confidence is in the LORD.
reflection: Putting your confidence in the Lord is a blessed way to live.

text: The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
reflection: God is good to those who wait for Him and seek Him.

text: Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
reflection: Worry can't add a single moment to your life. Hand it to God instead.

text: Therefore don’t be anxious.
reflection: You don't need to be anxious. Your Father knows what you need.

text: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself.
reflection: Tomorrow has its own concerns. Focus on today and trust God with the rest.

text: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me… and you will find rest for your souls.
reflection: Jesus is gentle and humble in heart. Learn from Him, and find rest for your soul.

text: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
reflection: The load Jesus gives is light. Let Him take what you were never meant to carry.

text: He awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, ‘Peace! Be still!’
reflection: Jesus spoke to the storm and it went calm. Bring Him the storm in your heart.

text: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?
reflection: Worry can't make you taller or add an hour to your day. Let it go.

text: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.
reflection: Through Jesus you have peace with God. That peace is the ground you stand on.

text: The peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
reflection: God's peace goes beyond understanding, and it guards your heart and mind in Christ.

text: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.
reflection: Marriage is a new oneness God designed. Ask Him to help you build a home where two lives grow together.

text: The soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
reflection: Jonathan and David show what deep friendship can be: loyal, loving and soul-close. Thank God for friends like that.

text: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
reflection: Life and work go better together. Don't be afraid to share the load with others.

text: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow.
reflection: Everyone falls sometimes. Be the friend who helps someone up, and let others help you.

text: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD.
reflection: Children are a gift from the Lord. Treat the young lives around you as the treasure they are.

text: Set a guard, LORD, over my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
reflection: Many hurts begin with careless words. Ask God to guard your mouth today.

text: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
reflection: Peace doesn't always happen by itself. Seek it, and actively pursue it in your relationships.

text: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
reflection: Hatred keeps conflict alive, but love chooses to cover wrongs. Choose love today.

text: He who walks with wise men grows wise, but the companion of fools suffers harm.
reflection: The people you spend time with shape who you become. Walk with those who are wise.

text: One who is slow to anger appeases strife.
reflection: A patient, calm response can defuse a quarrel. Take a breath before you answer.

text: When a man's ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
reflection: When your life pleases God, He can bring peace even in strained relationships.

text: He who covers an offense promotes love.
reflection: Not every offence needs to be repeated. Covering a fault with grace makes room for love.

text: Death and life are in the power of the tongue.
reflection: Your words carry real power. Use them to bring life to the people around you.

text: It is his glory to overlook a transgression.
reflection: There is honour in letting small offences go. Patience is a strength, not a weakness.

text: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
reflection: The way we guide children shapes the rest of their lives. Lead them toward God with patience and love.

text: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
reflection: The right word at the right time is a beautiful gift. Look for a chance to give one today.

text: Faithful are the wounds of a friend.
reflection: A true friend will tell you hard truths out of love. Value honesty that comes with care.

text: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man's friend.
reflection: Good counsel from a friend is sweet to the soul. Thank God for the people who speak into your life.

text: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend's countenance.
reflection: Good friends sharpen each other. Look for relationships that help you grow.

text: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kindly instruction is on her tongue.
reflection: Speak with wisdom and kindness. Gentle words leave a lasting mark on those you love.

text: Many waters can't quench love, neither can floods drown it.
reflection: True love is strong and enduring. Many waters can't put it out.

text: What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
reflection: Justice, mercy and humility: this is how God asks us to treat others and walk with Him.

text: He will turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers.
reflection: God cares about families coming back together. Pray for healing between generations.

text: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
reflection: Peacemaking is holy work. When you help bring peace, you reflect your Father in heaven.

text: First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
reflection: Reconciliation matters to God. If something stands between you and someone else, take a step to make it right.

text: Love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you.
reflection: Loving people who hurt you is hard. Start by praying for them and asking God to change your heart.

text: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
reflection: Forgiveness flows both ways. As you forgive others, you live in the freedom of God's forgiveness.

text: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother's eye, but don't consider the beam that is in your own eye?
reflection: Before pointing out someone else's faults, look honestly at your own. Humility heals relationships.

text: Whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them.
reflection: Treat others the way you want to be treated. It's a simple rule that changes everything.

text: If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone.
reflection: When someone hurts you, Jesus invites you to talk with them privately and honestly. It's a path toward peace.

text: Where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.
reflection: Jesus is present when His people gather. Your relationships can be a place where He dwells.

text: I don't tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.
reflection: Forgiveness isn't a one-time act. Ask God for the grace to keep forgiving.

text: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.
reflection: Marriage is something God joins together. Treat it as sacred, and invite Him into it.

text: You shall love your neighbor as yourself.
reflection: Love your neighbour as yourself. Ask who God has placed near you to love today.

text: Allow the little children to come to me!
reflection: Jesus welcomed children warmly. Make room for the little ones around you to come to Him.

text: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone.
reflection: Bring any grudge with you to prayer, and let God help you release it.

text: As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
reflection: Treat others the way you'd like to be treated. Kindness starts with you.

text: Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.
reflection: God has been merciful to you. Let that mercy flow to the people in your life.

text: Don't judge, and you won't be judged. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
reflection: Instead of judging, choose to forgive. Grace shown to others shapes your own heart.

text: Give, and it will be given to you.
reflection: Generosity is never wasted. Give freely of your time, love and kindness.

text: While he was still far off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
reflection: The father ran to his returning son. Let God's welcome shape how you welcome those who come back.

text: If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.
reflection: Honesty and forgiveness belong together. Speak truthfully, and be ready to forgive.

text: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another, just as I have loved you.
reflection: Jesus calls us to love one another the way He loves us: patiently and sacrificially.

text: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.
reflection: Love for one another is how the world recognises Jesus' followers. Let your love be visible.

text: This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
reflection: Jesus' command is clear: love one another as He has loved you.

text: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
reflection: The greatest love gives itself for others. Look for a way to put someone else first today.

text: They continued steadfastly in the apostles' teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayers.
reflection: The early church grew through shared teaching, meals and prayer. Real fellowship takes showing up.

text: It is more blessed to give than to receive.
reflection: There is real joy in giving. Look for someone you can bless today.

text: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor preferring one another.
reflection: Be devoted to one another in love. Try to outdo each other in showing honour.

text: Be of the same mind one toward another.
reflection: Seek harmony with others. Humility makes unity possible.

text: Repay no one evil for evil.
reflection: Don't pay back hurt with hurt. Ask God to help you respond with goodness.

text: Don't be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
reflection: You can overcome evil with good. Kindness is stronger than it looks.

text: Owe no one anything, except to love one another.
reflection: Love is the one debt we never finish paying. Keep loving the people around you.

text: Let us follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build up one another.
reflection: Choose what builds others up and brings peace. Small choices make strong relationships.

text: Now the God of patience and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind one with another.
reflection: Ask the God of patience and encouragement to give you unity with the people in your life.

text: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
reflection: Christ accepted you as you are. Welcome others in the same way.

text: Love is patient and is kind; love doesn't envy. Love doesn't brag, is not proud.
reflection: Love is patient and kind. Ask God to grow this kind of love in your heart.

text: Love doesn't seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil.
reflection: Love doesn't insist on its own way or keep score. Let go of a record of wrongs.

text: Love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
reflection: Love keeps hoping and keeps going. Ask God for love that perseveres.

text: Now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
reflection: Faith, hope and love all remain, but love is the greatest. Make it your priority.

text: Let all that you do be done in love.
reflection: Let love be the motive behind everything you do today.

text: Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace.
reflection: Aim for restoration, comfort and peace with one another. The God of love and peace is with you.

text: Through love be servants to one another.
reflection: Freedom in Christ is for serving one another in love, not just pleasing ourselves.

text: The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, self-control.
reflection: Patience, kindness and gentleness are fruit the Spirit grows in you. They transform every relationship.

text: With all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love.
reflection: Be humble, gentle and patient. Bear with one another in love.

text: Being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
reflection: Unity takes effort. Work to keep the peace that the Spirit brings.

text: Be angry, and don't sin. Don't let the sun go down on your wrath.
reflection: Anger is human, but don't let it settle in. Try to resolve conflict before the day ends.

text: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up.
reflection: Let your words build others up. Speak what will help, not what will hurt.

text: Be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
reflection: Be kind and tenderhearted. Forgive others as God in Christ has forgiven you.

text: Subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.
reflection: Healthy relationships are marked by mutual respect. Put others first out of reverence for Christ.

text: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it.
reflection: Christ's love is self-giving. Love your spouse with that same kind of care.

text: You fathers, don't provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
reflection: Parents shape hearts. Guide children with patience, not frustration, and point them to the Lord.

text: In humility, count others better than yourselves.
reflection: Humility values others highly. Look for ways to honour the people around you.

text: Each of you should not just look to his own things, but each person also to the things of others.
reflection: Notice the needs of others, not just your own. Love pays attention.

text: Put on a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance.
reflection: Each day you can choose compassion, kindness, humility and patience. Put them on like clothes.

text: Bearing with one another, and forgiving each other.
reflection: Bear with one another and forgive. God's forgiveness gives you the strength to forgive.

text: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
reflection: Love ties every other virtue together. Above everything, choose love.

text: Husbands, love your wives, and don't be bitter against them.
reflection: Love your spouse, and don't let bitterness take root. Tenderness keeps a marriage strong.

text: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt.
reflection: Let your conversations be full of grace. Kind words make a lasting difference.

text: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men.
reflection: Ask God to make your love grow and overflow toward others.

text: Always follow after that which is good, for one another, and for all men.
reflection: Always seek what is good for one another, not just for yourself.

text: Let's consider how to provoke one another to love and good works.
reflection: Think about how you can encourage someone toward love and good works today.

text: Let brotherly love continue.
reflection: Keep loving each other. Love is meant to continue, not fade.

text: Let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger.
reflection: Listen first, speak slowly, and be slow to anger. It's a recipe for healthier relationships.

text: The fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
reflection: Peacemakers sow seeds that grow into a harvest of righteousness. Be someone who brings peace.

text: Be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous.
reflection: Be like-minded, compassionate and humble. These qualities make love real.

text: Above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
reflection: Love deeply. Earnest love covers a multitude of wrongs.

text: Let's not love in word only, neither with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
reflection: Love shows up in actions, not just words. Find a practical way to love someone today.

text: Beloved, let's love one another, for love is of God.
reflection: Love comes from God. Every time you love others, you reflect Him.

text: Please heal her, God, I beg you.
reflection: Moses' prayer was short and desperate: 'Please heal her.' You can pray just as simply and honestly.

text: Everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, will live.
reflection: The Israelites were told to look up and live. When illness pulls your eyes down, lift them to God.

text: As your days, so your strength will be.
reflection: God gives strength that matches each day. You only need enough for today, and He will provide it.

text: The LORD listened to the voice of Elijah... and he revived.
reflection: God listened to Elijah's prayer for a sick child. He listens to your prayers too.

text: His flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
reflection: Naaman's healing came through a simple act of trust. Bring your body and your hopes to God.

text: The LORD listened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.
reflection: God heard Hezekiah's prayer for his people. Your prayers for yourself and others are heard.

text: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.
reflection: Trouble may come again and again, but God stays with you through each one.

text: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.
reflection: Even in suffering, God draws near and speaks. Listen for Him in this season.

text: The needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
reflection: You are not forgotten in your need. Your hope in God will not be lost.

text: You will light my lamp. The LORD my God will light up my darkness.
reflection: On dark days, God can light your lamp. Ask Him to bring light into this season.

text: You are my help; hurry to help me.
reflection: You can ask God to come quickly. He is your help when your strength is low.

text: Consider my affliction and my travail.
reflection: God sees your pain and how hard this is. You can bring Him every part of it.

text: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you.
reflection: Lift your voice to God, even if it's only a whisper. He hears your cry for help.

text: For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God.
reflection: Put your hope in the Lord. He hears, and He will answer.

text: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
reflection: When you don't know what to wait for, let your hope rest in God.

text: He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
reflection: When you feel stuck in a pit, God can set your feet on solid ground again.

text: The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.
reflection: God cares for those in trouble. You can trust Him with this hard day.

text: As for me, I will call on God. The LORD will save me.
reflection: Call on God. He is the one who saves.

text: I will cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.
reflection: Cry out to God Most High. He is able to carry out His purposes for you.

text: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.
reflection: Sometimes all you can say is 'Hear me, God.' That prayer is enough.

text: Your loving kindness is better than life.
reflection: God's love is better than life itself. Let it be your comfort when your body is weak.

text: Answer me, LORD, for your loving kindness is good.
reflection: Ask God to answer you out of His good and kind love. He is compassionate.

text: Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer.
reflection: You can ask God to hurry. He is your help and your deliverer.

text: Be to me a rock of refuge, to which I may always go.
reflection: God is a refuge you can always run to, even from a hospital bed or a sleepless night.

text: You are the God who does wonders.
reflection: You belong to the God who does wonders. Nothing is beyond His power.

text: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, and abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
reflection: God is good and full of love for all who call on Him. Call on Him now.

text: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.
reflection: Ask God to turn His ear to your cry. Your prayers enter His presence.

text: No evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
reflection: Rest in the shelter of God's care. He watches over your home and your life.

text: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.
reflection: God promises to show you His salvation. Your life is in His loving hands.

text: Don't hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
reflection: On the hardest days, you can ask God not to hide His face, but to answer quickly.

text: Who redeems your life from the pit; who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies.
reflection: God crowns you with love and tender mercies. Receive His kindness today.

text: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
reflection: God is gentle with you. He is full of compassion, grace and love.

text: He knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
reflection: God knows how fragile you are. He is tender with your weakness.

text: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
reflection: When people cried out to God in their trouble, He rescued them. Cry out to Him too.

text: Revive me according to your word.
reflection: Ask God to give you new life according to His Word.

text: Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.
reflection: Even from the depths, your cry reaches God.

text: You knit me together in my mother's womb. I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
reflection: God carefully formed your body. He knows it fully and cares for it.

text: I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy.
reflection: Tell God out loud what you're feeling. He welcomes your cry for mercy.

text: He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
reflection: God hears the cries of those who love Him. He is near when you call.

text: The LORD raises up those who are bowed down.
reflection: When illness bows you down, the Lord is the one who lifts you up.

text: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
reflection: Waiting for healing can make your heart ache. Bring that weariness to God; He understands.

text: Good news gives health to the bones.
reflection: Good news can lift the spirit and strengthen the body. Look for a reason to be encouraged today.

text: So you restore me, and cause me to live.
reflection: Hezekiah prayed through his illness and found God restoring him. Bring your prayers to God.

text: He won't break a bruised reed. He won't quench a dimly burning wick.
reflection: When you feel bruised and barely flickering, God is gentle. He won't break you.

text: The LORD has comforted his people, and will have compassion on his afflicted.
reflection: God has compassion on those who suffer. Let His comfort reach you today.

text: Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you.
reflection: Even when you feel forgotten in your illness, God has not forgotten you.

text: The LORD has comforted Zion. He has comforted all her waste places.
reflection: God can bring comfort to the barren places of life. He sees what feels empty.

text: With everlasting loving kindness I will have mercy on you.
reflection: God's mercy toward you is everlasting. His kindness won't run out.

text: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there?
reflection: When you long for a cure, remember there is a Healer who cares. Bring Him your need.

text: You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.
reflection: Call on God and pray. He promises to listen to you.

text: Though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
reflection: Even in grief and pain, God's compassion is great. His love is abundant.

text: You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, 'Don't be afraid.'
reflection: When you called, God came near and said, 'Don't be afraid.' He is near now too.

text: I will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick.
reflection: God is the Shepherd who binds up the hurt and strengthens the weak. He cares for you.

text: I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.
reflection: God is the one who gives breath and life. Every breath you take is a gift from Him.

text: I will save that which is lame, and gather that which was driven away.
reflection: God cares for the weak and the hurting. He gathers them close to Himself.

text: I will come and heal him.
reflection: Jesus was willing to go to the sick. He is willing to come to you, too.

text: Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.
reflection: Jesus honoured the centurion's trust. Bring your request to Him with whatever faith you have.

text: He healed all who were sick.
reflection: Jesus cared deeply about people who were sick. He hasn't changed.

text: Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
reflection: Jesus came for those who are sick and in need. You are exactly who He came for.

text: Healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
reflection: Jesus' ministry was full of healing and compassion. He sees your sickness and cares.

text: Many followed him, and he healed them all.
reflection: Crowds followed Jesus because He cared for their needs. Follow Him with yours.

text: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes.
reflection: Jesus was moved with compassion and reached out to touch. He feels compassion for you.

text: The blind and the lame came to him in the temple, and he healed them.
reflection: The sick came to Jesus, and He welcomed them. You can come to Him too.

text: He healed many who were sick with various diseases.
reflection: Jesus healed people with all kinds of illnesses. Bring Him your specific need.

text: He had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.
reflection: People pressed in just to get near Jesus. You can draw near to Him in prayer today.

text: If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.
reflection: The woman reached out to Jesus in hope. Reach out to Him with yours.

text: As many as touched him were made well.
reflection: People reached out to Jesus wherever He went. Reach out to Him today.

text: He was restored, and saw everyone clearly.
reflection: Jesus didn't give up until the man could see clearly. He is patient and persistent in His care.

text: The power of the Lord was with him to heal.
reflection: The Lord's power to heal was with Jesus. Bring your needs to Him in prayer.

text: Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.
reflection: Jesus noticed a woman others overlooked and spoke freedom over her. He sees you, too.

text: Immediately she stood up straight, and glorified God.
reflection: When Jesus touched her, she stood up straight and praised God. Let Him lift your head today.

text: Go your way. Your son lives.
reflection: The father believed Jesus' word and went home. Trust Jesus with the people you love.

text: One thing I know: that though I was blind, now I see.
reflection: Sometimes the simplest testimony is the strongest: 'I was blind, now I see.' God does real work in real lives.

text: Your heart will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy from you.
reflection: Sorrow is real, but Jesus promises a joy no one can take away.

text: They were all healed.
reflection: The early church saw God's healing power at work. Keep praying for yourself and others.

text: Jesus Christ heals you. Get up.
reflection: Jesus is the healer. Bring your body and your prayers to Him.

text: He was sick, nearly to death, but God had mercy on him.
reflection: Epaphroditus was gravely ill, and God showed him mercy. Pray for God's mercy in your own illness.

text: Who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver; on whom we have set our hope.
reflection: God has delivered before, and you can keep setting your hope on Him.

text: Hope doesn't disappoint us, because God's love has been poured out into our hearts.
reflection: Hope in God doesn't disappoint, because His love is poured into your heart.

text: Showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
reflection: God's loving kindness reaches across generations. His love is far bigger than one lifetime.

text: The LORD, the LORD, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
reflection: This is how God describes Himself: merciful, gracious, patient and overflowing with love.

text: You shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.
reflection: Loving your neighbour isn't optional for God's people. It's how we reflect who He is.

text: You shall love him as yourself.
reflection: God asks us to love the outsider as ourselves. Look for someone who needs welcome today.

text: You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
reflection: Love God with everything you are: heart, soul and strength. He is worthy of all of it.

text: The LORD your God, he is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness.
reflection: God is faithful. He keeps His promises and His love, generation after generation.

text: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow, and loves the foreigner.
reflection: God's love reaches the vulnerable and the overlooked. He calls us to love them too.

text: The LORD your God will circumcise your heart... to love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.
reflection: God Himself softens our hearts so we can love Him. Love for God is His gift to us.

text: Yes, he loves the people.
reflection: Simply and surely, God loves His people. That includes you.

text: He loved him as he loved his own soul.
reflection: Jonathan loved David as his own soul. Friendship like that is a gift from God.

text: Your love to me was wonderful.
reflection: David treasured Jonathan's love. Thank God for the people whose love has shaped your life.

text: You who keep covenant and loving kindness with your servants.
reflection: There is no God like ours, who keeps His promises and His loving kindness.

text: You are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
reflection: Even when His people failed, God remained ready to forgive, gracious and full of love.

text: Let those also who love your name be joyful in you.
reflection: Those who love God can find their joy in Him. Let His love make your heart glad.

text: I love you, LORD, my strength.
reflection: Tell God you love Him. He is your strength.

text: Remember, LORD, your tender mercies and your loving kindnesses; for they have been ever of old.
reflection: God's tender mercy and love are ancient and unchanging. You can lean on them today.

text: For your loving kindness is before my eyes.
reflection: Keep God's loving kindness before your eyes. Let it shape how you see everything.

text: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness.
reflection: Rejoice in God's love. He sees your troubles and knows your soul.

text: Oh love the LORD, all you his saints!
reflection: Love the Lord. He is faithful to those who are His.

text: The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.
reflection: Look around: the earth is full of God's loving kindness.

text: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens.
reflection: God's love reaches to the heavens. It is bigger than you can measure.

text: How precious is your loving kindness, God!
reflection: God's loving kindness is precious. Take refuge in the shadow of His wings.

text: Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.
reflection: Ask God to keep you safe in His love and truth every day.

text: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the midst of your temple.
reflection: Take time to think about God's loving kindness. Meditating on it fills your heart.

text: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness.
reflection: When you've failed, you can still come to God. His mercy flows from His great love.

text: I trust in God's loving kindness forever and ever.
reflection: Trust God's loving kindness forever. His love is a firm foundation.

text: For your loving kindness is great to the heavens.
reflection: God's love is great beyond the heavens. You can't reach the end of it.

text: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
reflection: In God, love and truth meet, and righteousness and peace embrace.

text: For your loving kindness is great toward me.
reflection: God's love toward you is great. He has rescued you from the depths.

text: I will sing of the loving kindnesses of the LORD forever.
reflection: Let your life be a song about God's love that never ends.

text: For I have said, 'Loving kindness will be built up forever.'
reflection: God's love is built to last forever. It will never be torn down.

text: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
reflection: Start your day by receiving God's love. It satisfies in a way nothing else does.

text: To proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night.
reflection: Speak of His love in the morning and His faithfulness at night. Bookend your day with Him.

text: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
reflection: As high as the heavens are above the earth, that's how great God's love is.

text: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
reflection: God's love removes your sins as far as the east is from the west. You are forgiven.

text: But the LORD's loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him.
reflection: God's love stretches from everlasting to everlasting. It has no beginning and no end.

text: Let your loving kindnesses also come to me, LORD.
reflection: Ask God to let His loving kindness come to you today. He delights to give it.

text: The earth, LORD, is full of your loving kindness.
reflection: God's love fills the whole earth. Look for signs of it today.

text: Oh how I love your law!
reflection: Loving God includes loving His Word. Let it become a delight to you.

text: The LORD is gracious, and merciful; slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
reflection: God is gracious and merciful, slow to anger and rich in love. That's who He is toward you.

text: The LORD preserves all those who love him.
reflection: God watches over all who love Him. You are kept by His care.

text: Don't let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck.
reflection: Keep kindness and truth close, like something you wear every day.

text: For whom the LORD loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
reflection: God's correction comes from love, the way a good father guides a child he delights in.

text: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
reflection: Wisdom loves those who love her. Seek God's wisdom, and you will find it.

text: He loves him who follows after righteousness.
reflection: God loves those who pursue what is right. Keep following Him.

text: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.
reflection: A simple meal shared in love is worth more than a feast without it.

text: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for.
reflection: Mercy and truth go together. God's love deals with our wrongs.

text: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness.
reflection: Kindness is what makes a person truly attractive. Let love show in how you treat others.

text: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
reflection: Pursue kindness and doing what is right, and you'll find real life.

text: His banner over me is love.
reflection: God's love is like a banner over you, declaring that you belong.

text: My beloved is mine, and I am his.
reflection: Belonging to someone and having them belong to you is a beautiful gift of love.

text: Set me as a seal on your heart... for love is strong as death.
reflection: True love is fierce and enduring, stronger than anything that tries to break it.

text: You have, in love for my soul, delivered it from the pit of corruption.
reflection: Out of love, God rescues. He cares about your soul.

text: Since you are precious in my sight, and honored, and I love you.
reflection: You are precious in God's sight, honoured, and loved. Let that sink in.

text: Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands.
reflection: Your name is engraved on God's hands. He will never forget you.

text: In his love and in his pity he redeemed them.
reflection: In His love and pity, God redeems His people. He carries them through every season.

text: I am the LORD who exercises loving kindness, justice, and righteousness, in the earth.
reflection: God delights in loving kindness, justice and righteousness. Knowing Him is the greatest treasure.

text: I will betroth you to me in righteousness, in justice, in loving kindness, and in compassion.
reflection: God commits Himself to His people with faithfulness, love and compassion.

text: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice.
reflection: God values a loving, merciful heart more than empty ritual.

text: I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love.
reflection: God draws His people with ties of love, gently and patiently.

text: For he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
reflection: Turn back to God anytime. He is gracious, merciful and full of love.

text: He doesn't retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.
reflection: God delights in showing mercy. His anger doesn't last, but His love does.

text: Show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.
reflection: Show kindness and compassion to those around you. It's the heart of true faith.

text: ‘I have loved you,’ says the LORD.
reflection: Before anything else, God says this: 'I have loved you.'

text: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have?
reflection: Loving those who love you is easy. Jesus calls us to a bigger, bolder love.

text: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.
reflection: Love God with all your heart, soul and mind. Everything else flows from this.

text: Jesus looking at him loved him.
reflection: Jesus looked at the young man and loved him. He looks at you with that same love.

text: You shall love your neighbor as yourself. There is no other commandment greater than these.
reflection: Loving your neighbour as yourself is one of the greatest commands. Start with the person in front of you.

text: Love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing in return.
reflection: Jesus calls us to love even our enemies and to give without expecting anything back.

text: But to whom little is forgiven, the same loves little.
reflection: When you realise how much you've been forgiven, love overflows.

text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
reflection: God loved the world so much that He gave His Son. That love includes you.

text: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
reflection: Jesus loved His friends personally, by name. He knows and loves you by name too.

text: If you love me, keep my commandments.
reflection: Love for Jesus shows itself in following Him. Let your love become action.

text: He who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him.
reflection: Those who love Jesus are loved by the Father, and Jesus reveals Himself to them.

text: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
reflection: Jesus loves you the way the Father loves Him. Stay in that love.

text: That the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.
reflection: Jesus prayed that the Father's love would live in you. That prayer is still at work.

text: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
reflection: God didn't wait for you to be good enough. Christ died for you while you were still a sinner.

text: Who will separate us from the love of Christ?
reflection: Nothing can separate you from the love of Christ. Not hardship, not fear, not anything.

text: Love doesn't harm a neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.
reflection: Love never harms a neighbour. It fulfils everything God asks.

text: For the love of Christ constrains us.
reflection: Christ's love is a powerful force. Let it shape your choices.

text: God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us, even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ.
reflection: God is rich in mercy. Because of His great love, He made you alive in Christ.

text: Being rooted and grounded in love.
reflection: Let your life be rooted and grounded in love. It holds you steady.

text: And to know Christ's love which surpasses knowledge.
reflection: Christ's love is bigger than anything you can understand. Keep discovering it.

text: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved you.
reflection: Walk in love, the same love Christ showed when He gave Himself for you.

text: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment.
reflection: Pray that your love would grow in wisdom and insight, not just in feeling.

text: Now the goal of this command is love, from a pure heart.
reflection: The goal of faith is love from a pure heart. Let love be your aim.

text: Love one another from the heart fervently.
reflection: Love one another deeply, from the heart.

text: Behold, how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God!
reflection: See how great the Father's love is: He calls you His child.

text: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us.
reflection: Love starts with God, not with us. He loved you first.

text: God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
reflection: God is love. When you live in love, you live in Him.

text: We love him, because he first loved us.
reflection: We love because He first loved us. His love makes our love possible.

text: Keep yourselves in the love of God.
reflection: Keep yourself in God's love. Stay close to the One who loves you.

text: You are a God who sees.
reflection: Hagar was alone and powerless, yet God saw her. When you feel unseen, He is the God who sees you.

text: Don't be afraid, for God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.
reflection: God heard the boy right where he was. He hears you in the exact place you are now.

text: I have surely seen the affliction of my people... and have heard their cry.
reflection: God sees the suffering of His people and hears their cry. Your situation is not hidden from Him.

text: Don't be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD.
reflection: When there's nothing you can do, stand still and watch for God. Some rescues are His alone.

text: There is none like God... who rides on the heavens to your help.
reflection: There is no one like God. He rides across the heavens to come to your help.

text: Go in this your might... Haven't I sent you?
reflection: Gideon felt weak, but God said, 'Go in the strength you have. Haven't I sent you?' Your little is enough with Him.

text: He raises up the poor out of the dust.
reflection: God lifts people up from the dust. Even the lowest place isn't beyond His reach.

text: He will keep the feet of his holy ones.
reflection: God guards the steps of His people. You won't walk this road unprotected.

text: My God, my rock, in him will I take refuge.
reflection: When you have nowhere else to turn, God is your rock and your refuge.

text: God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.
reflection: God is your strong fortress. He guides your way even when you can't see it.

text: You have enlarged my steps under me.
reflection: God makes room for your steps so you don't slip. He widens the path beneath you.

text: Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.
reflection: When Elijah was exhausted and hopeless, God gave him food and rest. He cares for your body and your soul.

text: LORD, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and the weak.
reflection: When you're the weak one facing something mighty, God is the helper who makes the difference.

text: We don't know what to do, but our eyes are on you.
reflection: It's okay not to know what to do. Keep your eyes on God; that's enough for now.

text: The hand of our God is on all those who seek him, for good.
reflection: God's gracious hand is on those who seek Him. Keep seeking Him.

text: Our God will fight for us.
reflection: You don't have to win this alone. Our God will fight for us.

text: He sets up on high those who are low.
reflection: God lifts up the lowly. Being brought low is never the end of the story with Him.

text: I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.
reflection: Nothing God purposes can be stopped. He is able to do all things.

text: Now I will arise, says the LORD; I will set him in safety.
reflection: God rises to protect the weak and oppressed. He sees, and He acts.

text: He sent from on high, he took me. He drew me out of many waters.
reflection: When you feel like you're drowning, God reaches down and draws you out.

text: Your right hand sustains me.
reflection: God's right hand holds you up. You are sustained by Him.

text: Send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion.
reflection: May God send you help and support. He is ready to strengthen you.

text: Don't be far from me, for trouble is near.
reflection: When trouble is close and help seems far, ask God to stay near. He hears.

text: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
reflection: Keep your eyes on the Lord. He can free your feet from whatever has trapped you.

text: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
reflection: God watches over His people, even in seasons of lack. He keeps them alive.

text: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.
reflection: You can ask God to stand up for you. He is your defender.

text: LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him?
reflection: God rescues the weak from those too strong for them. There is no one like Him.

text: A man's steps are established by the LORD.
reflection: God directs the steps of His people. You are not wandering without a guide.

text: Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, LORD.
reflection: You can ask God to hurry to your help. He welcomes that honest prayer.

text: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness' sake.
reflection: Ask God to rise up and help you, because of His unfailing love.

text: The LORD of hosts is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge.
reflection: The Lord of armies is with you. You are not facing this alone.

text: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
reflection: God is your helper. He holds up your soul.

text: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.
reflection: Human help has its limits. God's help does not.

text: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be greatly shaken.
reflection: God alone is your rock and fortress. With Him, you won't be shaken.

text: My salvation and my honor depend on God.
reflection: Your safety and your worth rest in God, not in your own strength.

text: For the LORD hears the needy, and doesn't despise his captive people.
reflection: God hears the needy. He never looks down on those who are trapped.

text: He will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
reflection: When you have no one to help you, God hears your cry and comes.

text: He will have pity on the poor and needy.
reflection: God has compassion on the weak and needy. He cares about you.

text: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name.
reflection: Ask God for help for the sake of His name. He is the God who saves.

text: You called in trouble, and I delivered you.
reflection: You called in trouble, and God rescued you. He can do it again.

text: Blessed are those whose strength is in you.
reflection: Those whose strength is in God are blessed. Let Him be your strength.

text: They go from strength to strength.
reflection: With God, you can go from strength to strength, one step at a time.

text: Hear, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
reflection: You can come to God just as you are: poor and needy. He listens and answers.

text: You, LORD, have helped me, and comforted me.
reflection: Remember the times God has helped and comforted you. He is the same today.

text: My hand will be established with him. My arm will also strengthen him.
reflection: God's hand steadies His servants, and His arm gives them strength.

text: Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him.
reflection: God rescues those who cling to Him in love. Hold on to Him.

text: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.
reflection: If the Lord had not helped, we would have gone silent. He is still your help.

text: Help me, LORD my God. Save me according to your loving kindness.
reflection: Help me, Lord, according to Your love. Pray it simply and honestly.

text: He will stand at the right hand of the needy.
reflection: God stands beside the needy. He is at your right hand.

text: He raises up the poor out of the dust.
reflection: God lifts the poor from the dust. He doesn't leave anyone there.

text: He is their help and their shield.
reflection: Trust in the Lord. He is your help and your shield.

text: I was brought low, and he saved me.
reflection: When you are brought low, God saves. He is gentle with the weak.

text: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.
reflection: When you were pushed toward falling, the Lord helped you. He is your helper still.

text: Save us now, we beg you, LORD.
reflection: 'Save us, Lord' is a prayer God welcomes. You can pray it today.

text: Hold me up, and I will be safe.
reflection: Ask God to hold you up. In His hands, you are safe.

text: Let your hand be ready to help me.
reflection: Ask God to keep His hand ready to help you. He is near.

text: Let my soul live, and it will praise you.
reflection: Ask God for life, and let your life become praise to Him.

text: Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
reflection: Your help comes from the One who made heaven and earth. There is no greater help.

text: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted.
reflection: God stands up for the afflicted. He cares about justice for you.

text: My loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer.
reflection: God is your love, your fortress and your deliverer. He has you covered.

text: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help.
reflection: Happy are those whose help is God. He doesn't fail.

text: He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
reflection: God is a shield to those who take refuge in Him. Run to Him.

text: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress.
reflection: God is a refuge for the poor and needy in distress. He shelters you.

text: The everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn't faint. He isn't weary.
reflection: When you are tired, remember: God never grows weary. His strength never runs out.

text: Don't be afraid... I will help you, says the LORD.
reflection: Even when you feel small and weak, God says, 'Don't be afraid. I will help you.'

text: I will bring the blind by a way that they don't know.
reflection: When you can't see the way, God will lead you along paths you don't know.

text: Behold, I will do a new thing.
reflection: God is doing a new thing. Look for it, even in the wilderness.

text: I will go before you, and make the rough places smooth.
reflection: God goes ahead of you to make the rough places level.

text: Behold, the LORD's hand is not shortened, that it can't save.
reflection: God's arm is not too short to save. Nothing is beyond His reach.

text: But the LORD is with me as an awesome mighty one.
reflection: The Lord is with you like a mighty warrior. You don't stand alone.

text: I called on your name, LORD, out of the lowest dungeon. You heard my voice.
reflection: Even from the lowest pit, God heard. He hears you too.

text: Though it takes time, wait for it.
reflection: God's timing may feel slow, but it is never late. Keep waiting on Him.

text: Who has despised the day of small things?
reflection: Don't despise small beginnings. God works through little things.

text: 'Lord, save me!' Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, and took hold of him.
reflection: When Peter began to sink, he cried out and Jesus immediately took his hand. Cry out; He reaches for you.

text: Lord, help me.
reflection: Sometimes the only prayer you have is 'Lord, help me.' It's enough.

text: The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
reflection: Jesus understands human weakness. Pray, and lean on His strength.

text: Have compassion on us, and help us.
reflection: You can ask Jesus for compassion and help. He is moved by your need.

text: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.
reflection: God lifts up the humble. He sees those who feel powerless.

text: Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened to you.
reflection: Keep asking, seeking and knocking. God responds to those who persist in prayer.

text: Men ought always to pray, and not to give up.
reflection: Jesus taught us to keep praying and not give up. Your prayers matter.

text: Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
reflection: When you don't know where else to turn, turn to Jesus. He has the words of life.

text: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever.
reflection: Jesus promised the Holy Spirit as your Helper, who stays with you forever.

text: In him we live, and move, and have our being.
reflection: In God you live and move and exist. You are held by Him every moment.

text: God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able.
reflection: God is faithful. He won't let you be tested beyond what you can bear, and He provides a way through.

text: That we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead.
reflection: When we reach the end of ourselves, we learn to rely on the God who raises the dead.

text: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think.
reflection: God is able to do far more than you can ask or imagine. Your limits are not His.

text: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.
reflection: God is at work in you, giving you both the desire and the strength to do what pleases Him.

text: He is able to help those who are tempted.
reflection: Jesus knows what it is to suffer and be tested. He is able to help you.
